logical_reasoning.question: If three machines produce 30 products in 5 hours, how many products will six machines produce in 5 hours?
logical_reasoning.answer: Each machine produces 10 products in 5 hours. Six machines will produce 60 products.

logical_reasoning.question: A sequence is 5, 10, 15, 20. What is the next number?
logical_reasoning.answer: 25. The difference between consecutive numbers is 5.

scenario_evaluation.question: You receive a programming task but do not understand the requirement. What would you do?
scenario_evaluation.answer: I would read the requirement carefully, identify what the program should do and ask questions to clarify anything I do not understand. Then I would create a small solution and test it.
